settings.lead: A gentle, wrapped-hug pressure vest for the dogs who tremble through thunderstorms, panic at fireworks, and pace by the door the moment you leave.

settings.text: Thunderstorms and the low rumble before them
The long, quiet minutes after you leave

settings.heading: Recognizing anxiety in your dog.
settings.body: Every storm season, every firework night, every time you reach for your keys — it starts again. The shaking you can't soothe. The hiding you can't coax them out of. You've tried holding them close, and wished you could stay that way all night.
settings.mood_quote: The sound they can't unhear — and the corner they hide in until it stops.

settings.title: Gentle, constant pressure
settings.text: A snug wrap-around fit that stays with them, so the comfort doesn't stop when your hands do.

settings.title: Soft, light, breathable
settings.text: Made to be worn through a whole storm without overheating or weighing them down.

settings.title: On in seconds
settings.text: An adjustable hook-and-loop closure means you can get it on before the first thunderclap.

settings.heading: How gentle, constant pressure helps.
settings.body: Furvago is designed to apply gentle, constant pressure around your dog's torso — the same comforting principle behind swaddling a baby or a weighted blanket. Many dog owners report their dogs settle faster and rest more easily once it's on.

settings.title: 30-day returns
settings.text: Used or not — send it back

settings.heading: One vest, available in three colors.
settings.body: Our whole store is built around getting this one thing right — a vest that helps your dog feel safe when the world feels like too much. Choose your size and color, and we'll take it from there.

settings.quote: "First thunderstorm with it on, and she actually lay down instead of shaking in the bathroom. That was everything."
"We put it on before we leave now. The neighbors say the barking has really settled down."
"Easy to get on a squirmy dog, and he doesn't try to wriggle out of it. That alone was worth it."

settings.eyebrow: Give them somewhere safe to go
settings.heading: Be prepared for the next storm.
settings.body: Free shipping, a 30-day return window, and a vest built to help your dog through the nights that scare them most.
